tagline: A new hotel, two minutes from Kabalana

copyBlocks.heading: Among cafés and restaurants
copyBlocks.body:
Cafés and restaurants surround the hotel, and there is a fruit stand nearby. Guests score the location 9.6 out of 10 on Booking.com.

Koggala Airport is about 5 km away.

copyBlocks.heading: New, and it shows
copyBlocks.body:
The hotel is new. On Booking.com one guest calls it “brand new”, another “a new facility”.

Booking.com guests score it 9.7 out of 10 for cleanliness and the same for comfort, and 9.4 for staff, across 34 reviews. On Google it has 5.0 out of 5 from 21 reviews.

copyBlocks.heading: Staying longer
copyBlocks.body: One guest wrote that they moved around many hotels before finding this one, then stayed over a month. Another extended their stay rather than go on to a different hotel.

copyBlocks.heading: Nine kinds of room
copyBlocks.body:
There are king rooms with a balcony or a garden view, superior kings, and a deluxe king on the ground floor with a private patio and a pool view. Family studios and suites sleep four, and the two-bedroom suite sleeps five.

Each room has a work desk, soundproofing and free WiFi. The family rooms have air conditioning and private bathrooms.

There is no published price list. Rates go by date, and the booking links show what is available.

copyBlocks.heading: Pool, restaurant, spa
copyBlocks.body:
The outdoor pool is in the middle of the hotel and open all year. The restaurant serves breakfast with local specialities and fresh pastries, plus Chinese, Indian and Italian dishes. There’s a coffee house on site too, and a spa and wellness centre.

For families there are the family rooms and an outdoor play area. Kids’ meals and babysitting cost extra.

copyBlocks.heading: Practicalities
copyBlocks.body:
The front desk is staffed 24 hours, with private and express check-in. Parking is free and private, but you need to reserve it. There’s an airport shuttle as well.

Housekeeping is daily. There is laundry, dry cleaning and ironing, bicycles to rent, non-smoking rooms, and facilities for guests with disabilities.

spot: Kabalana: a sandy beach break for beginners and intermediates, with The Rock reef A-frame for advanced surfers. The beach is two minutes from the hotel, on foot.
closing: Rates move with the dates. Booking.com and Agoda show what is available.
featureLine: A year-round outdoor pool, at the centre of the hotel.
